bundles.notes: Baseline bundle baked into APK 0.1.1-test (versionCode 2). Current live snapshot: Fix Round 1 engine, original music, new title art, mazed routes, 509 re-sliced walk sheets, fixed tile 61.
Identical to 2026.11.01-1 (current snapshot) plus a visible 'OTA v2' title-screen marker.

Fix Round 2: gym 4-8 + Champion page-condition fix (game completable again), Route 2 battleback restored, full Mart/Dept Store stocks, gyms 4-8 award badges, evolution stones respect type, Mach Bike refuses indoors, Dex totals /504, daycare compatibility + walking egg. Marker 'OTA v3'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass A: unified stat model for player + wilds + trainers (one formula from species base stats), base stats normalized by evolution stage (36 species), all damage formulas rescaled (avg turns-to-KO ~3.6 at Lv50), EXP rebalance (fewer wins per level), Stadium Lv50 band recalibrated to 620. Verified live: stats probe 87/87, wild battle + gym multi-turn, capture/save-load smoke, FULL 5-round Stadium clear (engine wins=1). Marker 'OTA v4'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass B: battle UI rebuilt to the Champions plate standard - status plates are static (foe top-right, ally left) and can never overlap a battler (art measured per bitmap and fit-capped; tallest roster art verified live), EXP row fully inside the ally plate, plates and battlers stay above MZ's opaque battle-window band at all times; HP shows as bar + PERCENTAGE on both sides, raw HP numbers removed everywhere in battle (incl. switch window); long species names shrink-to-fit instead of sliding under the type badge. Battle FX: type-colored impact bursts (bigger on KO), foe shake + red-flash hit reaction, player-side damage popups (stock MZ never renders them in front view), sink-and-fade player KO. Overworld camera zoom 1.5x with corrected touch mapping (perf-neutral on the rig: FPS ratio 0.93-1.00). Stadium party restore now returns members at true full HP (was 90%). js/ota.js restored to the bundle (missing from v3/v4 bundles). Verified: rig2 ship gate PASS 27/27, p2b live suite 18/18, unit suites FR1 10/10, FR2 11/11, P2A 5/5, P2B 13/13. Marker 'OTA v5'.

Engine Pass 2 sub-pass C: engine-side area encounters - all 10 encounter areas now roll their own designed tables (two-stage rarity: tier roll Common/Uncommon/Rare/Mythic with a quiet re-roll, then weighted species) instead of the legacy game-wide species 1-12 clamp. Route 1 is the gentlest area in the game: encounter step 12 -> 42 (fewest battles) and the softest fights (levels capped 2-5, stage-1 species only). Evolution-stage gating: every species is staged from its evolution chain (224 stage-1 / 176 stage-2 / 104 stage-3); each area has a max-stage gate so opening areas draw only base forms and evolved forms unlock by area depth (the per-area Mythic slot is a designer signature sighting; Route 1's mythic was swapped to a stage-1 species per the gating rule). Radiant Wanderer: a 1-in-10,000 Solgoddess (Lv 40) can replace a Route of Radiance (Map023) roll once you hold 4+ badges. Follower fix: the follower now always renders the lead's OWN walk sheet - Bubblix, Florabit and Bunspark had stale pre-rename sheets pointing at different creatures (Aquafox/Leafpup/Sparklet); all three sheets were regenerated from their own battlers and their data records corrected; the resolver can never silently substitute a wrong/generic sheet again (a missing sheet logs an exclusion instead). Verified: rig2 p2c live suite 11/11 (4,000-roll distribution, real Scene_Map trigger, all 9 starter-line followers sheet+bitmap), unit suites 53/53 (FR1 10, FR2 11, P2A 5, P2B 13, P2C 14), ship gate 26/27 with the one miss (smoke capture) re-run standalone at 8/8 - a throttled-rig timeout, documented in the Pass 2 report. Marker 'OTA v6'.

Starter-area provenance bundle: every remaining stock RPG Maker RTP asset visible in Wakaba Town, Prof. Kusu's Lab and Route 1 has been replaced with original art, verified in game (byte-identical fetch from the running game plus on-screen bitmap identity). 10 files swapped, nothing else: Prof. Kusu's intro portrait (img/pictures/People4_6.png, newly generated from our own Prof. Kusu master), the intro legendary Grimmorth (img/enemies/Goddess_of_death.png, now our own Ganjuko_Grimmorth art), the window skin on every dialogue box and menu (img/system/Window.png, original astral skin), the game-over screen (img/system/GameOver.png), follower emotion balloons (img/system/Balloon.png), touch-UI buttons (img/system/ButtonSet.png), chest / crystal / object sprite sheets (img/characters/!Chest.png, !Crystal.png, !Other1.png), and IconSet.png (the 11 cells visible in the starter stretch redrawn as original glyphs: 8 skill icons + capture Orb, Great Orb and Oran Berry item icons; a full-sheet redraw remains scheduled before the open-source release). Engine and species data are UNCHANGED from 2026.11.01-6 (engine md5 c5903fcd..., species md5 a56ee99a...); the bundle was verified file-by-file against the v6 bundle - exactly these 10 files plus the version marker differ. Marker 'OTA v7'.

Route enlargement bundle: Routes 4-8 (data/Map015.json, Map017.json, Map019.json, Map021.json, Map023.json) grow from empty 25x20 fields to 44x30 maps with real terrain for the first time - pine borders, a gate wall at the old east edge with a reachable far-side region beyond it, bent corridors, southern valleys, and per-route character (Route 4 deep forest, Route 5 scorched dirt road, Route 6 S-bend ridge, Route 7 canopy mire, Route 8 astral plateau with the Master Orb nook). No event was moved (every event keeps its exact coordinates and JSON), and encounter pacing is unchanged (encounterStep 30, per-area multiplier 1.0). Reachability was proven by two independent BFS implementations (offline + in-engine, zero orphan cells, every event reachable) and real held-key walks entry-to-exit on all five routes. Engine and species data are UNCHANGED from 2026.11.01-7 (engine md5 c5903fcd..., species md5 a56ee99a...); the bundle was verified file-by-file against the v7 bundle - exactly these 5 map files plus the version marker differ (7 entries). Marker 'OTA v8'.
